name: – Hristo Petrov – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Council Recommendation of 30 October 2020 on A Bridge to Jobs – Reinforcing the Youth Guarantee and replacing the Council Recommendation of 22 April 2013 on establishing a Youth Guarantee
part_text:
The Youth Guarantee is a promise to help every young person under 30 find a job, training, apprenticeship or education within four months of becoming unemployed or leaving school. This report reviews how that promise has worked since 2020 and asks for it to be strengthened. It wants better outreach to young people who are hardest to reach, more personalised support, better quality offers, and continued EU funding for youth employment.

- The report asks for stronger outreach, better quality offers and continued EU funding for youth employment.
- It affects young people under 30, especially those not in work, education or training.
- Next, Parliament votes on the report; it is not law and only sets out Parliament's position.
